UFC.rule: Each published session is a distinct event window; do not collapse sessions.

WWE.rule: Use official weekly schedule when available; never infer a show onto the wrong weekday.

Formula 1.rule: Treat practice, qualifying and race as distinct sessions when schedule data publishes them.

NASCAR.rule: Session names and race start are separate schedule facts.

NFL.rule: Broadcast network is event-specific and must be sourced; never infer network from team alone.

MLB.rule: Game is primary event; extra innings can extend live window.

NBA.rule: Game is primary event; overtime extends live window.

NHL.rule: Game is primary event; overtime/shootout can extend live window.
